Forge Steel 3-piece wire brush set suitable for effective cleaning and surface preparation across diverse trade and DIY projects. The durable kit includes brushes with nylon, carbon steel, and stainless steel bristles, making it ideal for mechanics, metalworkers, and general refurbishment tasks. The varied bristle types allow for targeted application, from gently cleaning sensitive components to aggressively removing stubborn rust, scale, old paint, and welding slag. Each brush also features a robust plastic handle for comfortable use and control.
